relationships.basis: John Glasgow's will of 14 March 1779 (Cumberland County Will Book C, pp.161-162; catalogue record peters-john-will-1779-fendrick-1944) names his wife Ann, daughter Lates, daughter Agnes and son Joseph, and says Ann is with child. Listing the wife and the children together and providing for them jointly supports Ann as Joseph's mother, but the will does not say she is, and an earlier wife is not excluded. Probable at 65%, apart from the father link (98%).
